content:
Why don't I believe our country's media? Well look at the below points and tell me if you do:

1. They claim "CJP protesters are foreign funded and it is a conspiracy to overthrow the government." 

Meanwhile the MEA (Ministry of External Affairs) cannot share any information related to that so these "news anchors know better than our intelligence agencies?"

2. "Delhi Police clarified there was no use of pellet gun."

Well Rahul Gandhi showed the proof ,that is, the student hit with a pellet gun and now suddenly authorities are looking into this matter after completely denying it.

3. "Sonam Wanchuk is an anti-national CIA or Chinese agent."

Well then why is our Prime Minister wishing for the well-being of such an anti-national person?
 
So when I call out biased media, am I the one doing wrong here or are you too much interested in the success of these biased narratives?
